packageRules.description: The runner images stay as they are: the package's glibc requirement follows the image it is built on, and the binary must keep running on Debian stable. Moving to a newer image is a decision for a person (see check-glibc.sh).
The OpenTelemetry crates are released together and must be updated together.
A patch update is a fix: the next release is a patch. Grouped, and merged once the checks have passed.
A minor update is a feature: the next release is a minor. Grouped, and merged once the checks have passed.
A major update is a breaking commit (the ! before the colon): the next release is a major. One pull request per dependency, merged by a person.
The Rust toolchain is pinned in rust-toolchain.toml only: the CI installs what that file says, so one update moves the CI, the builds and the checks together.
